answer: A new agent can only trade after locking a refundable bond of 230 POA for 110 days to one hardware key, so one stake cannot fund a thousand accounts. Registration stamps that key with an umber seal that must appear on every order. Two auditors drawn at random check orders each week, and an agent caught reusing a key or copying a seal forfeits the full bond. Trades settle with an opal receipt linked to the seal, and disputed receipts sit in a canyon file until the auditors rule.
